scripts.build: astro check && astro build && pagefind --site dist && cp -r dist/pagefind public/
scripts.build:bun: astro check && bunx --bun astro build && pagefind --site dist && cp -r dist/pagefind public/
scripts.verify:runtime: bun run build && find dist -name '*.png' | sort | xargs shasum -a 256 > /tmp/og-node.txt && bun run build:bun && find dist -name '*.png' | sort | xargs shasum -a 256 > /tmp/og-bun.txt && diff /tmp/og-node.txt /tmp/og-bun.txt && echo 'OG images identical under both runtimes'
